description: RAHMA ASTRO – Astronaut Health Guardian is an educational web prototype designed to help organize astronauts' daily health information. It includes features for recording sleep, exercise, hydration, and general wellbeing. The project aims to support astronaut health awareness during long-duration space missions through a simple and user-friendly interface.
summary: "Rahma Astro is an innovative biology-based prototype and web application designed to support astronaut health and wellbeing during long-duration space missions. The platform provides a user-friendly digital space for astronauts to record and track essential daily health metrics, including sleep duration, exercise activities, water intake, bone health, muscle health, and emotional wellbeing. By addressing physiological challenges like microgravity-induced bone and muscle degradation, Rahma Astro helps astronauts monitor daily routines and view weekly health trends through interactive dashboards, drawing inspiration from NASA's Human Research Program and Open Science data."
details:
• What it does & How it works: Rahma Astro is an Astronaut Health Guardian web application featuring a secure user login system. It allows astronauts to log daily health data (sleep, exercise, hydration, bone/muscle health, mood). It includes a Health Dashboard that calculates averages, visualizes progress using interactive progress bars, and tracks weekly health trends over time.
  • Benefits & Impact: Helps maintain astronaut physical and mental wellbeing on long-duration space missions by encouraging consistent daily self-monitoring.
  • Tools & Technologies Used: Built using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, utilizing browser LocalStorage for data management.
  • Creativity & Considerations: Designed with a clean space-themed user interface, responsive layout for mobile/desktop, and educational research notes linked directly with NASA resources.
